business_summary: Mingchen Health Co.,Ltd. engages in the development, production, and sale of personal health care products in China. The company operate through Daily Chemical Products and Online game segments. It offers skin care, shampoo, hair care, bath products and styling products under the Dihua Zhixiu, DIFASO, SunShine Fruit Oil, Mei Wang, First Collection, Golden Lion, Likoujian, High Tech Health, Green Effect, Yicai, Xiao Qiqi, and Fice brand name. In addition, the company offers online game operation services. Mingchen Health Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1994 and is based in Shantou, China.
business_summary_ko: Mingchen Health Co.,Ltd. 중국에서 개인 건강 관리 제품의 개발, 생산 및 판매에 종사합니다. 회사는 Daily Chemical Products 및 온라인 게임 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. Dihua Zhixiu, DIFASO, SunShine Fruit Oil, Mei Wang, First Collection, Golden Lion, Likoujian, High Tech Health, Green Effect, Yicai, Xiao Qiqi 및 Fice 브랜드 이름으로 스킨 케어, 샴푸, 헤어 케어, 목욕 제품 및 스타일링 제품을 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 온라인 게임 운영 서비스도 제공합니다. Mingchen Health Co.,Ltd. 1994년에 설립되었으며 중국 산터우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
